subject_scope.named: San Pedro de Atacama excursions; highland day trips and night-sky sessions

visit_profile.typical_visit: Four-hour lower-desert sunset trip, ten-hour highland route, or 2.5-hour outdoor astronomy session
visit_profile.hours_outdoors: Varies by product; exposed stops and outdoor observing, with vehicle travel between sites
bundled_sites: Piedras Rojas, Miscanti, Miñiques and Chaxa on selected highland circuits
visit_profile.transport_part_of_experience: Road travel connects exposed outdoor stops; it is not the entire visitor experience.
visit_profile.seasonal_versions: Llama describes stargazing and Moon-and-planets formats; summer route substitutions depend on access.
visit_profile.shelter_checked: Product inclusions confirm vehicle transport between stops. Telescope viewing and named scenic stops are outdoors; no heated observing enclosure is promised.
